title: Fixed borders added from the context menu being invisible in dark color schemes: they now use the new `--ht-custom-borders-default-color` theme variable (black in light schemes). Their `color` in `getBorders()` and `getCellMeta().borders` is now the CSS value `var(--ht-custom-borders-default-color, #000)` instead of `#000`, so read it as a CSS value, not a hex string.
